purpose: Controlled L20 replication of collaborator L4 pinned run, followed by conservative routing-rule assessment

gpu.name: NVIDIA L20
gpu.memory_clock: stock; capture actual per invocation; do not assume equal bandwidth to L4

preferred_toolchain.driver: record exact version and compatibility; collaborator driver 580.82.07

input_policy: All six quantized file hashes must match collaborator October manifest; if regeneration differs, resolve provenance before timing
rotation: Four binary order rotated each outer round; record positions, model order and actual wall times; six rounds is not a balanced four-world Latin square
primary: paired geometric mean throughput ratio at n=8 per model/type
secondary: full force_mmq curve at n=2..8; crossover exceeding same paired null-floor definition

controls.n1: all four route identically for these types

statistics.bootstrap: 95% percentile, 10000 resamples; record seed and implementation; descriptive, not simultaneous confidence
statistics.old_vs_new_datasets: Keep separate; never average different model hashes/toolchains/pins

before_timing: Verify all six quantized input hashes and source provenance
Independent same-source null rebuild and save CMakeCaches, compiler flags and binary hashes
Dense MUL_MAT numerical comparison for Q4_0/Q8_0, n=2..8, relevant geometries
Compute-sanitizer on diagnostic exact-allocation pool (separate from stock-pool timing); stock VMM alone can hide overreads
If n<8 shows invalid access, preserve evidence and do not publish those timings as validated; jointly agree the matched safe-source protocol rather than silently patching one world
telemetry: Per invocation timestamped SM/memory clocks, power, thermal state, clock-event reasons, actual achieved pin. Do not equate requested pin with held pin or per-invocation means with n8-only clocks.
interpretation: Same nominal clock reduces a confounder, does not prove nsm causality; rule needs dp4a precondition plus affected-model/shape regression review
server: Single L20 sufficient; no need rerun V100 stock now
remaining: Verify rented-host model download connectivity before prolonged build or timing
Restore six quantized hashes on rented host, concurrent with builds
CUDA numerical/memcheck gates and achieved pin verification on L20
diagnostic: force_mmq_exact_pool: exact cudaMalloc temporary allocations, CUDA Graph OFF; excluded from timing
correctness_coverage: 12 attention/FFN geometries per type at n2..8, 168 cases per route; excludes output head and full-model correctness
